_Requested by **Kacper**_

## Description

RFC-1823 implementation, task I16, part 4 of 8 (labs: Part of
https://github.com/software-mansion/react-native-screens-labs/issues/1925).
Stacked on #5037.

`RNSMenuItemUpdateOptions` / `RNSMenuUpdateOptions` parsed the
`setMenuItemOptions` / `setMenuOptions` command dictionaries themselves
(`+fromDictionary:`). By D2 parsing props is the react layer's job, so
it moves unchanged into a new react-side
`RNSStackHeaderMenuUpdateOptionsMapper`, called by the header config
component view. The options classes keep the typed values and
`applyOptions:`, and expose their initializers for the mapper.

### Alternatives for the header mappers (you asked for these to be
spelled out)

This PR, #5039 and #5040 implement option A of the question in the
thread:
- **A, these PRs: the dictionary mappers live in `react`.**
`RNSStackHeaderMenuMapper` (`+menuFromDictionary:`),
`RNSStackHeaderIconMapper` (`+iconFromDictionary:`) and the
`+fromDictionary:` half of the menu update options move to
`react/containers/stack/header`, like `RNSStackHeaderAppearanceMapper`
(D2). `core` receives only the typed menu and icon data. Cost: the
mappers' validation asserts (allowed-keys checks) now run on the react
side, which is where the JS contract they validate lives anyway.
- **B: keep them in `core`.** They are plain Objective-C over
`NSDictionary`, so the layer check would not object. Cost: `core` then
knows the JS shape of menus and icons (key names such as `children`,
`itemType`, `imageSource`), so any non-React consumer of `core` would
have to build React-shaped dictionaries to configure a header — the
coupling D2 exists to prevent.
- **C: split each mapper**, keeping a typed builder API in `core` (e.g.
`-[RNSStackHeaderMenuData initWith…]`, which already exists) and only
the dictionary walk in `react`. That is effectively A, since the typed
initializers are already in `core`.

## Changes

- New
`ios/react/containers/stack/header/RNSStackHeaderMenuUpdateOptionsMapper.{h,mm}`
(the two parsers and their helpers, unchanged).
- `RNSStackHeaderMenuUpdateOptions`: `+fromDictionary:` removed,
initializers public.

## Test plan

- `yarn check-ios-layers` passes.
- Builds at the top of the stack (#5042): iOS Debug (FabricExample)
locally at `98f60ce98`. tvOS and SPM last ran there on CI at
`edfafc585`, before the latest review fixes, and were green
(https://github.com/software-mansion/react-native-screens/actions/runs/40869227356,
https://github.com/software-mansion/react-native-screens/actions/runs/40869227242).
This PR's own CI runs are in the checks tab.
- Smoke on iOS (iPhone 17 and iPad Pro 11, iOS 27.0, Debug, scenarios
rendered from the app root), on `b6f7c4d`, the top of the stack before
the 2026-10-27 restacks, with no RedBox, LogBox or crash. All pass
unless noted:
  - Stack v5:
    - `test-stack-simple-nav`.
- `test-stack-lifecycle-events`: a JS pop gives `onDismiss`; the edge
swipe and the header back button give `onNativeDismiss`.
- `test-stack-back-button-ios`, `test-stack-header-menu-ios` (including
the `setMenuItemOptions` title / icon update),
`test-stack-header-menu-options-ios`.
- `test-stack-header-icon-ios`: sfSymbol, xcasset, imageSource and
templateSource on bar items and menus. The loading placeholder was not
exercised.
- `test-stack-header-title-appearance-ios`,
`test-stack-header-item-appearance-ios`,
`test-stack-header-selective-updates-ios`, `test-stack-subviews-ios`.
  - Tabs:
- `test-tabs-simple-nav`, `test-tabs-stale-update-rejection`,
`test-tabs-prevent-native-selection`, `test-tabs-lifecycle-events`.
- `test-tabs-item-icon`, including `tabBarTintColor`;
`test-tabs-item-title`, `test-tabs-item-badge`,
`test-tabs-system-item-ios`.
- `test-tabs-appearance-defined-by-selected-tab`,
`test-tabs-more-navigation-controller-ios`,
`test-tabs-special-effects-scroll-to-top`.
- `test-tabs-tab-bar-layout-direction`: rtl flips the tab order live.
- On iPad, `test-tabs-tab-bar-controller-mode` with `tabSidebar` shows
the icons on the UITab path.
- Orientation: `test-tabs-screen-orientation` and `stack-v4-orientation`
force and hold. `orientation-stack-in-tabs` and
`orientation-tabs-in-stack` behave as on `main`, including their known
failures
(https://github.com/software-mansion/react-native-screens-labs/issues/1955).
- Split (iPad): `test-split-color-scheme-ios`, including rotation;
`test-command-show-column`.
- Integration: `test-stack-tabs-stack-in-tabs-base-navigation`,
`test-form-sheet-stack-v5-nesting-stack-v5-in-form-sheet-ios`,
`test-stack-svm-tabs-special-effects`,
`test-form-sheet-scrollview-nesting-scrollview-in-form-sheet`,
`test-svm-configures-scroll-view`.
  - Legacy status bar screen: style and hidden take effect.
- Not confirmed against `main`: in `test-tabs-item-badge`, the selected
tab's badge renders purple, not the blue the scenario describes. It
renders the same on a build without the Tabs appearance changes.
- The scenarios were also run on a build of the stack up to #5029, with
the same results.

- Since that run: the move PRs' patches are unchanged. The review fixes
in #5020, #5024, #5027, #5029 and #5036, and #4868 merged into #5033,
are covered by the builds above but not yet by a new simulator run.
Later simulator runs (iPhone 17, Debug) covered the newer changes:
- After `c02d0a3` restored the `configProvider` getter through
#5028–#5042: 9 Tabs scenarios.
- After the shared `RNSImageLoader`: 5 icon scenarios on Tabs and the
Stack header.
- After the #5033 review fixes (`268db76`, `c356731`), at `bc639d913`:
`test-tabs-item-icon` and `test-stack-header-icon-ios`, with
image-source, template-source and SF Symbol icons, selected icons and
menu icons. No RedBox, LogBox or RNScreens log message.
- After the #5035 and #5036 review fixes, on the same tree as the top of
the stack: `test-stack-simple-nav` (push and pop, with the debug stack
dump printing the screen keys) and `test-stack-header-icon-ios`.

documenting the change.
- [ ] For API changes, updated relevant public types.
- [ ] Ensured that CI passes
